name: mcp.calendar.add
rests_on: agents-calendar CLI create VEVENT; summary plus dtstart and dtend as ISO-8601 with a UTC offset (a time without an offset is treated as UTC); exit 0 = created

dtstart.description: Start, ISO-8601 with a UTC offset (e.g. 2026-11-29T16:00:00+01:00). A time without an offset is treated as UTC.

dtend.description: End, ISO-8601 with a UTC offset (e.g. 2026-11-29T17:00:00+01:00). A time without an offset is treated as UTC.

calendar.description: Target calendar collection name (e.g. Arbeit) or URL (optional)
